title: 第十三回 小试神功第十四回 滴血还魂
slug: 驭音心经第七十回狼心逞乱
lines: 第十三回小试神功
入夜，巫陷天坑洞，月光从洞外射下一线光，光影洒在一老一少师徒二人的脸上。
“徒儿，你准备好了吗？”
九蝉目光如炬道。
“徒儿准备好了，师父。”
孤鹤雁的声音坚定而清澈。
“好，那我就把毕生灵修传授与你。”
言罢，九蝉缓缓闭上双眸，神色庄严而凝重，他双掌缓缓抬起，掌心朝上，仿佛托起了整个天地。
孤鹤雁深吸一口气，双膝跪地，也将双掌合在师父的手掌上。
刹那间，二人周身环绕起淡淡的灵光，如同星辰闪烁，环绕在他们身旁。
九蝉低吟之声空灵悠远，如同天外之音，一股强大的能量如潮水般涌进孤鹤雁体内。
孤鹤雁觉得自己的每一根骨骼都被重塑，每一块肌肉都被增强，体内充满了无穷的力量，仿佛一匹脱缰的骏马，迫不及待想要奔腾于草原之上。
渐渐地，那股能量如潮水退去，直到停息，孤鹤雁的体温由炽热转为正常。
九蝉缓缓睁开双眼，眼中闪过一丝欣慰：“好了，徒儿。”
“你已经拥有我全部的能力和灵修，接下来面对鼠怪，全看你了。”
九蝉淡笑着，随即伸出手，从口中取出一颗脱落的牙齿！
“师父！”
孤鹤雁看的泪如泉涌，他压抑不住心中的感动，一把将九蝉紧紧抱住。
“好了，徒儿，你不要悲伤。”
九蝉轻轻拍拍孤鹤雁的背：“师父已经不是仙界的人，老去也是一定的。”
“能看到我的灵修在你的身上发光继承，我便心满意足了。”
“了师兄托付我的事，我已经完成了。”
“你是个好孩子，师父不会看错你，你抓紧揣摩师兄的心经吧，那可能是你一生最大的财富。”
“我累了，真得躺下歇息歇息了。”
言罢，九蝉一转身，便侧身躺下，手中的佛转刚轻轻捻动两下，便沉沉睡去。
孤鹤雁盘腿而坐，开始在心中默念心经，经文自他唇间跃过，灵云自他心头升起，氤氲升华。
往日一幕幕，像铺开的闪亮画卷一般，从他脑海中迅速闪过：奶奶的笑容，爷爷的慈祥，容月妈妈般温馨的体香，卉云白皙的面庞，九蝉呵护的灵光……，这一切如同无尽的能量，在他心间流淌。
一只蝙蝠从暗空中飞过，狡黠的窥视牢房，孤鹤雁如有所见，轻抬食指，一声默念，那蝙蝠旋即坠地，无声无息地死去。
孤鹤雁缓缓睁开眼睛：“玄劈一字诀。”
“着力快！”
“师父，师父。”
听到耳边轻声的呼唤，九蝉睁开眼，回身一看，就见孤鹤雁一脸笑意的跪在他身边，开心的看着他。
“师父，你可算醒啦。
你睡了小一天了，我都没敢叫醒你。
该吃饭啦，我整了点吃的给你，起来吃饭吧。”
九蝉闻言，顿觉腹中空空，传了毕生的功夫和灵修，肚子岂能不饿？他转头一看，不禁得惊喜不已！
但见一侧地上，放着一个托盘，托盘之上，一个干净的瓷碗，一碗清水，旁边是几个新鲜的水果和煮熟的土豆，还有一只烤得金黄酥脆的烤兔，最奇妙的是，旁边还有个一坛子。
“还有酒吗？”
九蝉眼中闪过一丝兴奋的光。
“哪能没有酒呐，师父。”
孤鹤雁笑着回答：“知道你老爱喝酒吃肉，我就整了一些，估摸着你老也该饿了，赶紧趁热吃吧。”
“嗯嗯，不错，不错。”
九蝉揽过酒坛，迫不及待地打开盖子，深吸一口酒香，随后痛饮一口，满意地点点头，脸上露出极大的满足和快乐。
“嗯，好！

Chapter 13: A small test of magic skills
At night, the witch sank into the Tiankeng Cave. The moonlight cast a ray of light from outside the cave, and the light and shadow fell on the faces of the master and the apprentice, an old man and a young man.
"Disciple, are you ready?"
Jiu Chan said with eyes as bright as a torch.
"Disciple is ready, Master."
Gu Heyan's voice was firm and clear.
"Okay, then I will teach you my lifelong spiritual practice."
After saying this, Jiu Chan slowly closed his eyes, his expression solemn and solemn. He slowly raised his palms, palms facing up, as if he was holding up the entire world.
Gu Heyan took a deep breath, knelt on his knees, and put his palms together on his master's palms.
In an instant, a faint aura surrounded the two of them, like twinkling stars, surrounding them.
The low voice of the nine cicadas was ethereal and distant, like sounds from outside the sky, and a powerful energy surged into Gu Heyan's body like a tide.
Gu Heyan felt that every bone of his body had been reshaped, every muscle had been strengthened, and his body was filled with endless power, like a runaway horse, eager to gallop across the grassland.
Gradually, the energy receded like a tide until it stopped, and Gu Heyan's body temperature turned from hot to normal.
Jiuchan slowly opened her eyes, a trace of relief flashed in her eyes: "Okay, disciple."
"You already have all my abilities and spiritual skills. The next time you face the rat monster, it all depends on you."
Jiu Chan smiled lightly, then reached out her hand and took out a fallen tooth from her mouth!
"Master!"
Gu Heyan burst into tears watching this. He couldn't suppress the emotion in his heart and hugged Jiu Chan tightly.
"Okay, disciple, don't be sad."
Jiu Chan gently patted Gu Heyan on the back: "Master is no longer a member of the immortal world, and it is inevitable that he will grow old."
"I will be satisfied if I can see my spiritual practice shine and be inherited in you."
"I have completed what my senior brother has entrusted me with."
"You are a good boy. Master will not misjudge you. Please hurry up and try to understand Senior Brother's Heart Sutra. That may be the greatest wealth in your life."
"I'm tired. I really need to lie down and rest."
After saying this, Jiuchichan turned around and lay down on her side. She gently twisted the Buddha's Turn in her hand twice before falling into a deep sleep.
Gu Heyan sat cross-legged and began to recite the Heart Sutra silently in his heart. The sutra jumped from his lips, and the spiritual cloud rose from his heart, and the clouds sublimated.
Scenes of the past flashed through his mind like a shining scroll: grandma's smile, grandpa's kindness, Rong Yue's mother's warm body fragrance, Huiyun's fair face, Jiucicada's caring aura... all of these were like endless energy flowing in his heart.
A bat flew through the dark sky and peered slyly into the cell. If he saw something, Gu Heyan raised his index finger and said silently, and the bat immediately fell to the ground and died silently.
Gu Heyan slowly opened his eyes: "Xuanbi Yizi Jue."
"Strength quickly!"
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
"Master, Master."
Hearing the soft call in her ear, Jiu Chan opened her eyes, turned around and saw Gu Heyan kneeling beside him with a smile on her face, looking at him happily.
"Master, you are finally awake.
You've been sleeping all day, and I didn't even dare to wake you up.
It's time to eat. I've prepared some food for you. Get up and eat. "
When Jiu Chan heard this, he suddenly felt his stomach was empty. After a lifetime of hard work and spiritual cultivation, how could he not be hungry? When he turned around to look, he couldn't help but be pleasantly surprised!
But I saw a tray on the ground on one side. On the tray, there was a clean porcelain bowl, a bowl of water, a few fresh fruits and cooked potatoes, and a roasted rabbit that was golden and crispy. The most amazing thing was that there was a jar next to it.
"Any more wine?"
Jiuchan's eyes flashed with excitement.
"How can we not have wine, Master?"
Gu Heyan replied with a smile: "I know you always like to drink wine and eat meat, so I took some measures. I guess you must be hungry, so eat it while it's hot."
"Yeah, okay, not bad."
Jiu Chan took the wine jar, couldn't wait to open the lid, took a deep breath of the aroma of the wine, then took a swig, nodded with satisfaction, her face showing great satisfaction and happiness.
"Well, good!
